method: Source review, graph traces with coverage checks and direct-source verification, disposable Git fixtures, HTTP boundary probes, native extension-loader check without a model request.
findingsFixed: Pi dangling file/parent symlinks could authorize writes outside the checkout.
Sensitive-path filtering missed common credential/config/key stores.
Codex tool lifecycle summaries copied raw shell commands into the journal.
Hidden Git index flags could make owner edits appear clean.
Repository clean/smudge/process filters and executable merge drivers were not refused before app Git operations.
An implicit union merge driver could silently settle conflicting implementations.
testProbeCorrection: Initial added HTTP tests used Node Fetch, which discarded a forged Host. Replaced with node:http HEAD requests; no server change was required.

validation.probe: changed-file exact environment credential-value exclusion and evidence JSON syntax
validation.limitation: Not a general secret detector; Biome excludes docs/evidence.

compatibilityLimits: Configured executable Git filters, including Git LFS, and custom executable merge drivers are refused without changing configuration.
Assume-unchanged, skip-worktree and sparse index state require an owner-prepared compatible checkout. Flags/files are preserved.
remainingLimits: Codex read-only sessions can read outside their worktree; no OS isolation or race-proof containment is claimed.
Model reports and owner-declared test output are retained without automatic secret scrubbing; filename filtering cannot detect arbitrary embedded secrets.
OpenCode refused-tool turn loss remains open and was not changed.
Optional Pi model-configured startup was BLOCKED by an empty fresh-home catalog; loader-only verification passed without credentials.
liveModelTests: INTENTIONALLY OMITTED (cost); no new model prompts or live approval actions
